Full-text counts: Mycielski/Grotzsch/M4/29/19/38/29/edge-ideal/fractional-chromatic/triangle-free 0; Waldschmidt 1 (bibliography only). Antecedent chain traced: Def 4.13 defines resurgence rho(I)=sup{a/b: I^(a) not subset I^b}; Rem 4.14-4.15 give 1<=rho<=h and a/b>rho implies containment; Lemma 4.16 instantiates to (rho(I)<h) => (I^(hn-C) subset I^n for n>>0); Ex 4.18 instantiates to Fermat/Klein/Wiman point-configs with rho=3/2 (h=2) => I^(2n-2) subset I^n; Thm 4.2 instantiates to space monomial curve P with P^(4) subset P^3 => I^(2n-2) subset I^n for n>=6. Searched 'by the above proposition/with these properties/further examples' chains: all terminate at monomial curves, F-pure quotients, or named point-configs; none terminates at any graph edge ideal, M4, or 29/19/38/29 values. So no broader construction projects onto the M4 triple.
